articles.title: Serious risks at EU borders, fundamental rights agency warns
articles.summary: The EU Agency for Fundamental Rights says any emergency migration measures should comply with EU and international law.

articles.title: What would it take for Sweden's Centre Party to back Ulf Kristersson as PM?
articles.summary: Matilda Molander, head of the green and liberal think tank Fores, shook up Sweden's political world last week with an article outlining the painful concessions the Sweden Democrats might need to make for the Centre Party to switch sides.
